'''Keldas Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Keldas reported that one of Thul's former vassal houses has taken to the sea as [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and have been harrying Thul holdings. Since these pirates come ashore to resupply their ships, Keldas puts an extra bounty on them and tasks an Imperial spacer to deal with the threat.
